ISO IEC 42006 Control Item(s): Certification body governance, impartiality, competence, process, and management-system requirements for ISO/IEC 42001 audits.
rationale: External Audit: AI Audit engages an accredited certification body whose competence, impartiality and process 42006 governs; the control holds the certification scope and audit relationship.

ISO IEC 42006 Control Item(s): Audit planning, assessment, evidence review, certification decisions, surveillance, and recertification.
rationale: Internal Audit: AI Audit performs the readiness assessment against the evidence a 42006-conforming audit will sample.

ISO IEC 42006 Control Item(s): Auditor, certification personnel, and AIMS role competence requirements.
rationale: Partial alignment: 42006 competence requirements apply to auditors; Governance Training develops the internal competence of risk owners and committee members who face the audit.

ISO IEC 42006 Control Item(s): Nonconformity handling, corrective action, complaint handling, and follow-up.
rationale: Partial alignment: Incident Lessons Learned drives corrective action closure; 42006 nonconformity and complaint handling apply to the certification body, and the organization answers them through corrective action records.
